phase_name: Human Approval Trusted Provenance Contract Freeze
summary: Phase 149O.1B -- Human Approval Trusted Provenance Contract Freeze: investigated Root 2B (approver-authorization mapping) only, per governing-prompt scope discipline (did not reopen the Model A/B/C/D/E signer-model comparison 149O.1A already resolved). Checked all three of 149O.1A's candidate bootstrap-boundary mechanisms directly against this repository's actual current deployment with primary-source evidence: (1) distinct OS user/principal -- confirmed absent via whoami/git config user.email (agent and human both run as OS user atilamadai); (2) external service/KMS enrollment -- confirmed absent via repo-wide grep for signing/hardware/credential primitives (112 matches, all docstring disclaimers or third-party-secret redaction, unchanged from 149O.1A) and pyproject.toml (still only jsonschema dependency); (3) external human-authenticated review gate -- the one mechanism 149O.1A could not verify because it required inspecting remote hosting-platform configuration outside that phase's scope. This phase queried the actual GitHub repository directly (gh api repos/atimad/pcae-harness/branches/main/protection, .../collaborators, ssh-add -l) and found branch protection nominally requires one PR review but enforce_admins=false (repository owner can push directly to main, matching this repository's actual commit history of direct pushes), the sole collaborator is the repository owner (no second human account exists to serve as reviewer), and the SSH credential used for git push is the same key present on this machine that the agent process also has access to -- mechanism 3 is therefore not merely unconfigured but structurally insufficient for this single-maintainer, shared-credential deployment. Selected Bootstrap Model Class B (separate OS security context: a dedicated OS principal owning the trusted approver registry, distinct from the agent's own OS principal) over Class A (hardware-mediated enrollment alone -- does not by itself answer where the enrollment record lives) and Class C (external registry/review-gate -- rejected per the concrete GitHub findings and the absence of any provisioned KMS/service), satisfying the governing prompt's requirement to choose exactly one model class rather than leaving them co-equal. This is a selection of target architecture, not a claim that the boundary exists today: because no distinct OS principal currently exists in this repository's real deployment, the Bootstrap Trust Statement's mandatory field ('why the autonomous agent cannot enroll itself') cannot be filled in concretely for the current state of this repository. Re-ran the self-enrollment attack and verifier-key-replacement attack analysis against these concrete findings and confirmed both are NOT BLOCKED in the repository's current, real deployment -- sharper and more conclusive than 149O.1A's 'unverified' characterization of the same gap. Per the governing contract template's own instruction ('if any field cannot be filled concretely: DO NOT FREEZE') and the phase's own decision rule ('if approver authorization remains agent-writable -> do not freeze'), this phase does NOT freeze HATP-001 v1.0 and does not create docs/contracts/HUMAN_APPROVAL_TRUSTED_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT.md. Produced the full analysis document (docs/PHASE_149O_1B_HUMAN_APPROVAL_TRUSTED_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md) covering: Root 2B investigation with command-level evidence; bootstrap model class selection and rejection rationale for the other two classes; the honestly-incomplete Bootstrap Trust Statement per the mandatory template; updated threat-capability matrix showing the agent-column cells 149O.1A marked 'unverified' now resolved to 'confirmed possible today'; B-149O-1..4 mapping (all remain OPEN, with B-149O-4 specifically sharpened by this phase's registry-boundary finding); RAE-001/CHGR-001/RWMPC-001/PBPA-001/PBPC-001/IWC-001/AESIC-001/TAMC-001 compatibility reconfirmation (all COMPATIBLE AS-IS, headers independently re-read and confirmed FROZEN this phase, unamended). Zero production code changed this phase (git status --short confirms zero src/pcae/** diff, zero docs/contracts/** diff). No GitHub repository configuration was modified -- branch protection and collaborators were inspected read-only via gh api only. Fast Green re-run twice for stability: an initial parallel-worker run showed one test-isolation flake (tests/test_backend_cli.py::TestBackendReviewCreate::test_create_persists_to_latest) that passed cleanly in isolation and on the confirming stable rerun (4391 passed, exact match to entering baseline) -- classified as a parallel-worker test-isolation flake unrelated to this phase's doc-only diff, not a regression. AG3/AG5 remain unwired; RAE-001/RWMPC-001/PBPC-001/PBPA-001/CHGR-001 all byte-unchanged; Runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable throughout (confirmed via pcae runtime inspect before and during this phase). Evidence substrate readiness: NOT READY (unchanged from 149O.1A). See docs/PHASE_149O_1B_HUMAN_APPROVAL_TRUSTED_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md.
tests_added_or_updated: Zero new tests added. This is an architecture/contract-freeze-attempt/documentation-only phase; no test files were created or modified. Fast Green was re-run unmodified as inherited regression evidence (one flaked-and-passed-in-isolation result on the first parallel run, stable 4391-passed result on rerun).
